// A three-degree-of-freedom rotational joint (shoulder, hip): the anchors
// coincide while orientation is free. TwistAxisA is the twist reference axis
// in body A's frame; SwingLimit bounds the cone deviation from that axis and
// TwistLimit bounds rotation about it.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ball_joint)
type BallSocketJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    TwistAxisA: Direction3D;
    SwingLimit: AngularLimit;
    TwistLimit: AngularLimit;
}
